fullPassage: If we take an evolutionary look at our beginnings, we see a life in which high levels of physical activity were required for survival. Even one century ago, most people needed to be physically active to work, to travel, and to take care of homes and families. Our modern world has engineered such activity out of our lives. There are fewer manual jobs, we do not need to travel on foot, we do not need to hunt and harvest for our food, and many domestic chores have been mechanized. While these changes have created many benefits for our longevity and quality of life, they have also created many problems. Lack of sufficient physical activity has now been linked to at least 17 unhealthy conditions, almost all of which are chronic diseases or considered risk factors for chronic diseases. Adrianne Hardman has summarized this serious situation for public health: "Physical inactivity is a waste of human potential for health and well-being."

questions.passage: If we take an evolutionary look at our beginnings, we see a life in which high levels of physical activity were (A)[optional / required] for survival. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

① required — drawbacks — sufficient: drawbacks(단점)은 benefits(이점)의 반의어 ←오답
② required — benefits — sufficient: 원문 일치 ←정답
③ optional — benefits — sufficient: optional(선택적)은 required(필수적)의 반의어
④ required — benefits — excessive: excessive(과도한)는 sufficient(충분한)의 반의어

questions.passage: If we take an evolutionary look at our beginnings, we see a life in which high levels of physical activity were required for survival. Even one century ago, most people needed to be physically active to work, to travel, and to take care of homes and families. Our modern world has __________. There are fewer manual jobs, we do not need to travel on foot, we do not need to hunt and harvest for our food, and many domestic chores have been mechanized. While these changes have created many benefits for our longevity and quality of life, they have also created many problems. Lack of sufficient physical activity has now been linked to at least 17 unhealthy conditions, almost all of which are chronic diseases or considered risk factors for chronic diseases. Adrianne Hardman has summarized this serious situation for public health: "Physical inactivity is a waste of human potential for health and well-being."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 현대 사회는 그러한 활동을 우리 삶에서 제거했다(engineered such activity out of our lives).
det.analysis:
① linked to at least 17 unhealthy conditions: 뒤 문장 내용이나 Our modern world has + 빈칸 문맥과 불일치
② been mechanized over the past century: 주어(Our modern world)와 문법적으로 어색
③ engineered such activity out of our lives: 원문 일치 — 현대 사회가 활동을 제거함 ←정답
④ created many benefits for our longevity: 뒤 문장 내용이며 문맥 불일치
